mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (with the rate not in a tightening phase).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by > 0.5pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when UNRATE increases by > 0.5pp from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% from the prior month signals a broad-based economic contraction, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by > 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%), a subsequent rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises by > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% from the prior month signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of the periods when PAYEMS increases by > 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands) signals a weakening housing market, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when HOUST < 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% from the prior period signals a broad economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline by > 0.5% from the prior period.

mechanism_narrative: In a deep recession characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 4.0%.
